aries.style: boldly and first, with a spark that hates to wait
aries.profile: Aries is the first breath of spring after a long winter, the green shoot that cracks the frozen ground because it simply cannot stay down any longer. This is the sign of the beginner, the one who leaps before the plan is finished and somehow lands on their feet more often than not. Aries energy is honest to a fault: what you see is what is burning inside. It loves a challenge, a race, a cause worth fighting for, and it gets bored the moment things turn into maintenance. The gift here is courage, the willingness to go first so that others can follow. The lesson is patience, and learning that not every closed door needs to be kicked in. Aries rules the head, and you will often see it lead with the forehead: decisive, quick to anger, quicker to forgive. When this fire is tended well it is the hearth that gets everyone moving on a cold morning. When it is neglected it becomes a brush fire. Candle magic, red jasper and a good run in the woods all help Aries burn clean.
aries.shadow: rushing, picking fights, starting ten things and finishing none

taurus.profile: Taurus is the meadow in full May bloom, bees heavy on the clover, the sign that knows the body is holy and the senses are a way of praying. Ruled by Venus, Taurus wants beauty it can touch: good bread, soft wool, a garden that comes back every year. This is the steadiest energy in the zodiac. Once Taurus commits, to a person, a home, a craft, it stays, and it builds something that lasts. That same rootedness can harden into stubbornness, the bull planted in the field refusing to budge even when the field is on fire. Taurus teaches us that slowness is not laziness; it is how oaks are made. Its magic is earthy and practical: money jars, kitchen witchery, rose quartz under the pillow, herbs dried in bundles from the rafters. Taurus rules the throat, and many Taureans have a voice worth listening to, singing or speaking. The lesson is learning to let go of what no longer feeds you, even when it is comfortable.
taurus.shadow: clinging, possessiveness, refusing change until it is forced

gemini.style: curiously and quickly, talking it through
gemini.profile: Gemini is the late spring breeze that carries pollen and gossip in equal measure. This is the sign of the twins, of conversation, of the mind that wants to know a little about everything and will happily tell you all of it. Ruled by Mercury, Gemini is quick, funny, adaptable and endlessly curious; it collects ideas the way a magpie collects shiny things. It thrives on variety, on learning, on a good debate over coffee. The shadow side is scatter: so many threads that none of them get woven, and a mind that will not stop chattering at three in the morning. Gemini reminds us that words are spells. What we say, write and repeat becomes the shape of our days. Its magic lives in journals, sigils, letters burned in the fire, and in learning one more thing about the world. Gemini rules the hands, lungs and nerves, so breathwork and writing by hand are good grounding tools. The lesson is depth: staying with one question long enough to hear its real answer.
gemini.shadow: nervous scatter, gossip, saying the clever thing instead of the true one

cancer.style: tenderly and protectively, guided by feeling
cancer.profile: Cancer begins at the summer solstice, the longest day, when the Sun is at its peak and starts to turn back toward the dark. Ruled by the Moon, this is the sign of home, of mothers and grandmothers, of the kitchen table where everyone ends up. Cancer feels everything, often before anyone has said a word, and it remembers everything too. It carries a hard shell for good reason: the inside is soft, and it has been hurt before. Cancer energy builds nests, feeds people, keeps the family recipes and the family secrets. Its shadow is moodiness, retreat, holding grudges like heirlooms. This sign teaches that sensitivity is a strength and a skill. Its magic is moon magic: full moon water, ancestral altars, salt at the threshold, soup made with intention. Cancer rules the chest and stomach, and stress lands there first, so a Cancer heart needs safe places to put its feelings down. The lesson is nurturing yourself as fiercely as you nurture everyone else.
cancer.shadow: retreating into the shell, guilt as a tool, carrying old hurts

leo.style: warmly and dramatically, from the heart
leo.profile: Leo is high summer, the Sun at full strength over golden fields, the sign ruled by the Sun itself. This is the energy of the performer, the creator, the generous host, the one who lights up the room and wants you to have a good time in it. Leo is big-hearted and loyal, brave in the way of lions protecting their own. It needs to be seen, and that is not vanity so much as a plant needing light: an unseen Leo wilts. The shadow is pride, drama, and a fragile ego that takes criticism as a wound. Leo teaches us that joy is sacred and that creating, whether it is art, children, a party or a ritual, is a way of honouring the divine spark in us. Its magic is sun magic: sunflower offerings, gold candles, Lammas bread, anything done with flair and a full heart. Leo rules the heart and spine. The lesson is learning to shine without needing applause, and to let others take the stage too.
leo.shadow: needing applause, drama, taking criticism as an attack

virgo.style: carefully and precisely, with an eye for what could be better
virgo.profile: Virgo is the harvest, the careful hands that know which grain is ready and which needs another week. Ruled by Mercury, this is the sign of craft, health, herbcraft and service. Virgo notices everything: the typo, the cough, the plant that needs repotting, the friend who is not quite okay. It wants things to work well, and it will quietly fix them while everyone else is still talking. Virgo is the herbalist and the healer of the zodiac, practical magic made real through tinctures, routines and lists. The shadow is worry and perfectionism, a critical voice turned mostly inward, never feeling finished or good enough. Virgo teaches that small daily devotions matter, that a tidy altar and a cup of tea made mindfully can be as powerful as any grand ritual. It rules the gut and digestion, and a worried Virgo feels it in the belly. The lesson is self-compassion: you are allowed to be a work in progress, and so is everyone else.
virgo.shadow: perfectionism, self-criticism, worrying instead of resting

libra.style: gracefully and diplomatically, weighing every side
libra.profile: Libra opens at the autumn equinox, when day and night stand equal for a moment before the dark takes the lead. Ruled by Venus, this is the sign of the scales: balance, justice, partnership and beauty. Libra wants things to be fair and lovely, and it has a gift for seeing every side of a story. It is the diplomat, the matchmaker, the one who knows exactly which candle colour suits the room. Libra comes alive in relationship; it understands itself by mirroring others. The shadow is indecision and people-pleasing, keeping the peace at the cost of your own truth. Libra teaches that harmony is not the absence of conflict but the art of holding opposites. Its magic is love magic and beauty magic: rose baths, mirror work, art as offering, cords tied with care. Libra rules the kidneys and lower back, organs of balance and filtering. The lesson is choosing, and trusting that a fair choice made with love is better than no choice at all.
libra.shadow: people-pleasing, fence-sitting, keeping peace at your own cost

scorpio.style: intensely and privately, all or nothing
scorpio.profile: Scorpio is deep autumn, the season of Samhain, when the veil is thin and the leaves rot into next year's soil. Ruled by Mars and Pluto, this is the sign of death and rebirth, sex and secrets, power and transformation. Scorpio does not do anything halfway. It wants the truth beneath the truth, the conversation at two in the morning, the bond that would survive a fire. It is fiercely loyal and fiercely private, and it remembers betrayal for a very long time. Scorpio is the witch's sign in many ways: comfortable with shadow, drawn to the occult, unafraid of grief. The shadow side is control, jealousy, and a sting held ready just in case. Scorpio teaches that what we bury becomes compost, and that endings feed beginnings. Its magic is shadow work, ancestor work, banishing, scrying in dark water, and the honest look in the mirror. Scorpio rules the reproductive organs and the processes of elimination. The lesson is trust: letting someone see you all the way down.
scorpio.shadow: control, suspicion, holding a sting ready just in case

sagittarius.style: freely and optimistically, aiming at the horizon
sagittarius.profile: Sagittarius is the archer drawing back the bow under the late autumn stars, aiming beyond the hills for something it cannot quite name yet. Ruled by Jupiter, this is the sign of travel, philosophy, faith, teaching and laughter. Sagittarius wants meaning, and it is willing to cross oceans, read the whole library, or try every path up the mountain to find it. It is honest, sometimes bluntly so, generous, funny and allergic to cages. The shadow is restlessness and excess: too much, too far, too soon, and promises made bigger than the calendar allows. Sagittarius teaches that the journey is the teacher and that faith is something you practise, not something you own. Its magic is travel charms, candle wishes, divination by book, and any ritual done outdoors under a wide sky. Sagittarius rules the hips and thighs, the parts of us made for moving. The lesson is commitment: staying long enough in one place for wisdom to put down roots.
sagittarius.shadow: restlessness, over-promising, preaching instead of listening

capricorn.style: patiently and strategically, built to last
capricorn.profile: Capricorn begins at the winter solstice, Yule, the longest night, when the Sun is reborn and everything is quiet and cold. Ruled by Saturn, this is the sign of the mountain goat, climbing slowly and surely toward the summit while others give up halfway. Capricorn is responsible, ambitious, dry-witted and deeply loyal, often the one everyone leans on. It understands time: that good things take years, that structure protects what we love, that the ancestors' wisdom is worth keeping. The shadow is rigidity, workaholism and a coldness that hides a very tender heart. Capricorns often feel old when young and grow lighter with age. This sign teaches that discipline can be devotion and that boundaries are a kind of love. Its magic is long-game magic: prosperity spells, ancestral work, stones and bones, protection woven into the bones of the house. Capricorn rules the bones, knees and teeth. The lesson is rest, and letting the mountain wait while you enjoy the view.

aquarius.style: originally and independently, a little ahead of its time
aquarius.profile: Aquarius is the deep winter sky, crisp and starry, when the world is asleep and ideas arrive like snowflakes. Ruled by Saturn and Uranus, this is the sign of the water bearer, pouring knowledge out for everyone. Aquarius is the rebel, the inventor, the friend who believes in a better world and shows up at the meeting to build it. It values freedom, truth and community, and it does not much care what is normal. Aquarius often feels like an outsider and turns that into a superpower, seeing what others miss. The shadow is detachment: living in the head, loving humanity but finding individual humans exhausting, being stubborn in the name of being different. Aquarius teaches that we belong to each other and that the future is something we make together. Its magic is star magic, technology witchcraft, group ritual, and spells for justice and liberation. It rules the ankles and circulation. The lesson is letting feelings in, not just ideas.
aquarius.shadow: cool detachment, contrarianism, living only in the head

pisces.style: dreamily and compassionately, feeling its way
pisces.profile: Pisces is the end of winter melting into spring, snowmelt running to the sea, the last sign of the zodiac holding a little of all the others. Ruled by Jupiter and Neptune, this is the sign of the two fish swimming in opposite directions: one toward the world, one toward the dream. Pisces is psychic, artistic, compassionate and porous, absorbing the moods of every room it enters. It is the mystic, the poet, the healer, the one who cries at commercials and means it. Pisces knows that the boundaries between us are thinner than we pretend. The shadow is escapism: losing yourself in other people, substances, fantasies, or simply in not choosing. Pisces teaches that softness is not weakness and that imagination is a doorway to the sacred. Its magic is water magic, dream work, tarot, music, sea salt baths and spells cast in the bath by candlelight. Pisces rules the feet and lymph. The lesson is boundaries, so the fish can swim without drowning.
pisces.shadow: escapism, martyrdom, losing yourself in other people

sun.rules: your core self, vitality and the story you are living
sun.meaning: The Sun is the heart of the chart: your vitality, your will, the quality of light you bring into a room. It is not everything you are, but it is the fire at the centre that everything else orbits. Your Sun sign describes how you shine when you are well and what you need to feel truly alive. Its house shows where in life you are meant to grow brightest. Over a lifetime the Sun is something you grow into, so it often feels more true at forty than at fourteen.

moon.rules: your feelings, instincts, memory and what makes you feel safe
moon.short: how you feel and what soothes you
moon.meaning: The Moon is your inner tide: feelings, moods, instincts and the needs you had before you had words for them. It shows how you comfort yourself, what home feels like, and how you mother and want to be mothered. The Sun is who you are in the daylight; the Moon is who you are at three in the morning. If you want to know what someone needs when they are hurting, look at their Moon. Honouring your Moon sign is one of the gentlest forms of self-care astrology offers.

mercury.rules: how you think, speak, learn and connect ideas
mercury.meaning: Mercury is the messenger: thought, speech, learning, writing, travel and the little exchanges of daily life. It describes how your mind works, how you take in the world and how you explain it to others. Some Mercury placements think in pictures, some in lists, some in feelings, some in arguments. Understanding yours can end years of feeling misunderstood. Mercury also rules spells of the spoken and written kind: every intention you write down is Mercury at work.

venus.rules: love, beauty, pleasure, values and what you attract
venus.short: how you love and what you value
venus.meaning: Venus is the planet of love and beauty, but also of values: what you find precious, how you spend money and time, and what you are drawn toward. It describes how you give and receive affection, your taste, your style and the kind of pleasure that feeds you. Venus is also the magnet in the chart, showing what you naturally attract. Love magic, glamour, art and self-worth all live under Venus.

mars.rules: drive, desire, anger, courage and how you go after things
mars.meaning: Mars is your engine: drive, desire, courage, anger and sexuality. It shows how you go after what you want, how you fight, and what gets your blood up. A healthy Mars is the energy to start, defend and finish things. A frustrated Mars turns into irritation, burnout or turning anger on yourself. Knowing your Mars helps you find the kind of action, exercise and passion that keeps your fire clean.

jupiter.rules: growth, luck, faith, wisdom and generosity
jupiter.meaning: Jupiter is the great benefic: growth, luck, abundance, faith, wisdom and teachers. It expands whatever it touches. Jupiter's sign shows the style in which you find meaning and good fortune; its house shows where life tends to open doors for you. Jupiter takes about twelve years to circle the zodiac, so its returns at 12, 24, 36 and onward often mark new chapters of growth. Its shadow is excess: too much of a good thing.

saturn.rules: discipline, time, limits, responsibility and mastery
saturn.short: where you build mastery the slow way
saturn.meaning: Saturn is the old teacher: time, limits, responsibility, structure and mastery. It shows where life asks you to work hardest and where, with patience, you become truly skilled. Saturn can feel like fear or restriction when you are young, and like hard-won authority as you age. Its return, around 29, 58 and 87, is a famous rite of passage, when life asks you to grow up in the area Saturn rules for you. Saturn's gifts come slowly, and they last.

uranus.rules: change, freedom, awakening and the unexpected
uranus.meaning: Uranus is the awakener: sudden change, rebellion, genius, freedom and the lightning bolt of insight. It spends about seven years in each sign, so its sign describes your generation's revolution; its house shows where in your own life you need freedom and where the unexpected tends to strike. Uranus breaks what is too rigid so that something truer can emerge.

neptune.rules: dreams, spirituality, imagination and dissolving boundaries
neptune.meaning: Neptune is the mystic: dreams, intuition, spirituality, art, compassion and illusion. It dissolves boundaries, which can be holy or confusing depending on the day. Neptune stays about fourteen years in a sign, so its sign speaks to a generation's dreams. Its house shows where you are most inspired, most sensitive and most in need of grounding so that the fog does not swallow you.

pluto.meaning: Pluto is the lord of the underworld: power, transformation, endings and rebirth. It moves very slowly and marks whole generations by sign. Its house in your chart shows where you face the deepest changes of your life, where you encounter power struggles and where you discover a strength you did not know you had. Pluto does not tidy things up; it composts them.

node.rules: the direction of your growth in this life
node.short: the path you are growing toward
node.meaning: The North Node is not a planet but a point where the Moon's path crosses the Sun's. Astrologers read it as your soul's direction: the qualities you are here to grow into, which often feel unfamiliar and a little scary. Its opposite point, the South Node, describes what comes easily from long practice, the comfortable groove. Growth comes from moving toward the North Node while bringing the South Node's gifts along.

1.title: Self and body
1.phrase: the first house, the self, the body and the way you meet the world
1.text: The first house is the doorway of the chart: your body, your appearance, your first instincts and the face you show before anyone knows you. Planets here are visible from a mile away; they colour your whole presence.

2.title: Money and worth
2.phrase: the second house of money, possessions, skills and self-worth
2.text: The second house holds your resources: money, belongings, talents and, underneath them, your sense of your own worth. It shows how you earn, spend and keep, and what makes you feel secure.

3.title: Mind and neighbourhood
3.phrase: the third house of communication, siblings, learning and the local world
3.text: The third house is everyday thinking and talking: siblings, neighbours, short journeys, school, writing and the messages that fly back and forth. It is your mind at street level.

4.title: Home and roots
4.phrase: the fourth house of home, family, ancestry and private life
4.text: The fourth house sits at the bottom of the chart like a root cellar: home, family, ancestors, the past and your private inner life. It shows what you need to feel safe and where you come from.

5.title: Joy and creation
5.phrase: the fifth house of creativity, romance, children and play
5.text: The fifth house is the house of joy: creativity, romance, children, play, performance and anything you make for the love of it. It shows how you have fun and how you express your heart.

6.title: Work and health
6.phrase: the sixth house of daily work, health, routines and service
6.text: The sixth house is the daily round: work, chores, routines, health, pets and service to others. It is where devotion becomes habit, and where the body keeps score of how you live.

7.title: Partners
7.phrase: the seventh house of partnership, marriage, contracts and open enemies
7.text: The seventh house faces the first across the chart: partners, marriage, close collaborators and the people who mirror us, including rivals. It shows what you seek in others and what you learn through them.

8.title: Depths and shared power
8.phrase: the eighth house of intimacy, shared resources, death, the occult and transformation
8.text: The eighth house is the deep water: sex and intimacy, shared money, inheritance, grief, death, the occult and the transformations that change you for good. It is the witch's house of mysteries.

9.title: Faith and far journeys
9.phrase: the ninth house of travel, philosophy, faith, higher learning and publishing
9.text: The ninth house is the far horizon: long journeys, foreign places, higher learning, religion, philosophy, publishing and the big questions. It shows how you search for meaning.

10.title: Calling and reputation
10.phrase: the tenth house of career, calling, reputation and public life
10.text: The tenth house is the top of the chart, the noon sky: career, calling, reputation and what you are known for. It shows the mark you want to leave and how the world sees your work.

11.title: Friends and future
11.phrase: the eleventh house of friends, community, hopes and causes
11.text: The eleventh house is your people: friends, groups, covens, communities, causes and the future you hope for. It shows the circles you belong to and the dreams you share.

12.title: The hidden and the holy
12.phrase: the twelfth house of solitude, dreams, the unconscious, retreat and spirit
12.text: The twelfth house is behind the veil: solitude, dreams, secrets, retreat, hospitals and temples, the unconscious and the spirit world. Planets here work quietly, in private, and often become spiritual gifts.

planet_in_house_lead.sun: Your light shines most fully through
planet_in_house_lead.moon: Your heart finds its home in
planet_in_house_lead.jupiter: Luck and growth come easily through
planet_in_house_lead.saturn: Life asks for patience and mastery in
planet_in_house_lead.uranus: Sudden change and the need for freedom live in

sun.aries: With the Sun in Aries you are built to begin. You come alive when there is something to start, defend or win, and you feel most yourself when you are moving. Your honesty is refreshing and your courage gets other people off the couch. The work of your life is learning to channel that fire, so that it lights the way instead of scorching the path, and discovering that patience can be its own kind of bravery.
sun.taurus: With the Sun in Taurus you are the steady heart of any room. You build slowly and well, trust what you can touch, and know how to make life beautiful with very little. People rely on your loyalty and calm. You shine brightest when you are tending something that lasts: a garden, a home, a craft, a love. Your growth comes from letting change in gently, before it has to knock the door down.
sun.gemini: With the Sun in Gemini you are a bright, quick mind that wants to know everything and tell everyone. Conversation is your oxygen and curiosity your compass. You can be the funniest, most adaptable person in the room, and you connect people and ideas without trying. You shine when you are learning, writing, teaching or talking. Your growth lies in choosing a few threads and weaving them deep.
sun.cancer: With the Sun in Cancer you are a keeper of hearths and hearts. You feel deeply, remember everything and protect the people you love like a tide guarding the shore. Home is not a place for you so much as a feeling you create. You shine when you are nurturing, cooking, gathering, remembering. Your growth comes from caring for yourself as tenderly as you care for others, and from coming out of the shell on your own terms.
sun.leo: With the Sun in Leo you are meant to shine, and you make other people shine too. Warm, generous and creative, you bring the party, the play and the courage. You need to be seen and appreciated, and that is nothing to apologise for. You glow brightest when you are creating, performing, leading or loving out loud. Your growth is letting your light stay steady even when nobody is clapping.
sun.virgo: With the Sun in Virgo you are a healer and a craftsperson at heart. You notice what others miss, you love to be useful, and you have a gift for making things work better. Daily rituals and small devotions are your quiet magic. You shine when you are tending, fixing, studying or serving something you believe in. Your growth is turning your gentle, discerning eye on yourself with kindness instead of criticism.
sun.libra: With the Sun in Libra you are the weaver of harmony. You see every side, love beauty and fairness, and come alive in partnership and good company. You have a gift for making people feel welcome and for smoothing rough edges. You shine when you are creating balance, beauty or justice. Your growth comes from trusting your own voice and making choices, even ones that ruffle a few feathers.
sun.scorpio: With the Sun in Scorpio you are made for depth. You feel intensely, love fiercely and see through pretence in a heartbeat. You are drawn to mystery, to the hidden, to the truth beneath the surface, and you are not afraid of the dark. Your life moves in cycles of ending and rebirth, each one making you stronger. You shine when you transform pain into power. Your growth is in trusting people enough to let them in.
sun.sagittarius: With the Sun in Sagittarius you are a seeker with an arrow pointed at the horizon. You need freedom, adventure, laughter and big ideas, and you bring hope wherever you wander. Teaching, travelling, learning and believing are how you feel alive. Your honesty can be bracing and your optimism contagious. You shine when you are exploring. Your growth is learning to stay, so that wisdom has time to grow roots.
sun.capricorn: With the Sun in Capricorn you are a builder of things that last. Patient, capable and quietly ambitious, you climb steadily while others sprint and fall. People lean on you, and you carry responsibility well, sometimes too well. Your dry humour hides a deeply loyal heart. You shine when you are achieving something meaningful over time. Your growth is in letting yourself rest and play, and remembering you are loved for who you are, not only for what you do.
sun.aquarius: With the Sun in Aquarius you are a visionary and a free spirit. You think differently, care about the future and the collective, and refuse to be put in a box. Friends and causes matter enormously to you. You shine when you are innovating, rebelling for good reasons or building community. Your growth comes from letting feelings in as warmly as you welcome ideas, and from letting people get close to the real you.
sun.pisces: With the Sun in Pisces you are a dreamer, mystic and empath. You feel what others feel, imagine worlds that do not exist yet and carry a natural spirituality. Art, music, water and intuition are your native languages. You shine when you are creating, healing or connecting to something larger than yourself. Your growth is in building boundaries strong enough to keep your gentle heart safe in a loud world.

moon.aries: With the Moon in Aries your feelings arrive fast and hot and leave just as quickly. You need independence, action and honesty to feel safe, and you soothe yourself by doing something: a walk, a workout, a project. Sitting still with a feeling is your hardest lesson, and anger is often the first face of hurt for you.
moon.taurus: With the Moon in Taurus you find comfort in the senses: good food, soft blankets, music, nature and routine. You need stability and affection you can feel. Your emotions are steady and loyal, slow to change and slow to heal when hurt. Grounding rituals and time in the garden restore you.
moon.gemini: With the Moon in Gemini you process feelings by talking, writing and thinking them through. You need mental stimulation and someone to share your day with. Your moods change like weather, and boredom can feel like sadness. Journaling and good conversation are your best medicine.
moon.cancer: With the Moon in Cancer, the Moon's own sign, your emotional life is deep, tidal and intuitive. Home, family and belonging are everything. You care for others instinctively and absorb the moods of a room. You need a safe nest, and you heal by being cared for in return, which can be hard to ask for.
moon.leo: With the Moon in Leo you need warmth, appreciation and room to express yourself. You love generously and want to be cherished in return. Creative play, laughter and affection fill your cup. When you feel overlooked, it hurts more than you let on; a little recognition goes a long way for you.
moon.virgo: With the Moon in Virgo you feel safe when life is in order and you are being useful. You show love through acts of service and practical care. Worry is your emotional default, so routines, tidy spaces, herbs and useful work calm you. Learn to let yourself rest without earning it.
moon.libra: With the Moon in Libra you need harmony, beauty and partnership to feel at peace. Conflict unsettles you, and you will often smooth things over before you have even noticed your own feelings. A lovely space and a kind companion restore you. Your growth is in naming what you need, even when it disturbs the calm.
moon.scorpio: With the Moon in Scorpio your feelings run deep, private and powerful. You need trust, intimacy and truth; anything shallow leaves you cold. You sense hidden motives and hold on to hurts. Shadow work, ritual and a few deeply trusted people help you transform intensity into healing.
moon.sagittarius: With the Moon in Sagittarius you need freedom, adventure and meaning to feel at home. You lift your mood with travel, learning, laughter and open skies. You bounce back quickly, sometimes by skipping past feelings. Faith and philosophy are real comfort to you; so is room to roam.
moon.capricorn: With the Moon in Capricorn you feel safest when you are in control and things are handled. You learned early to be responsible, and you may hide vulnerability behind competence. Achievement and structure soothe you. Your growth is in letting others carry you sometimes, and letting your soft heart be seen.
moon.aquarius: With the Moon in Aquarius you need space, friendship and freedom to feel comfortable. You process feelings at a little distance, through ideas, and care deeply about your community. Too much emotional intensity can make you withdraw. Friends who give you room are your true family.
moon.pisces: With the Moon in Pisces your emotional world is vast, dreamy and porous. You feel everything, often for everyone, and you need solitude, music, water and spiritual practice to wash off what is not yours. Compassion is your gift; boundaries are your medicine. Your dreams carry real messages.

mercury.aries: Mercury in Aries thinks fast and speaks first. You are decisive, direct and quick-witted, and you love a debate. Slow down before sending the angry message.
mercury.taurus: Mercury in Taurus thinks slowly, practically and thoroughly. You learn by doing and, once you know something, you really know it. Your words carry weight and calm.
mercury.gemini: Mercury in Gemini is quick, curious and versatile, at home in its own sign. You juggle ideas, love words and can talk to anyone. Focus is your friend.
mercury.cancer: Mercury in Cancer thinks with the heart and remembers everything. You are intuitive, imaginative and tender with words, and you learn best where you feel safe.
mercury.leo: Mercury in Leo speaks with warmth, drama and conviction. You are a natural storyteller and teacher, and your words can light people up.
mercury.virgo: Mercury in Virgo is precise, analytical and skilled, strong in its own sign. You notice details, solve problems and explain clearly. Do not let worry run the show.
mercury.libra: Mercury in Libra weighs every side, speaks diplomatically and loves good conversation. You are a natural mediator, though deciding can take a while.
mercury.scorpio: Mercury in Scorpio thinks deeply, probes for the truth and keeps secrets well. Your words can heal or sting; you know exactly where to aim them.
mercury.sagittarius: Mercury in Sagittarius thinks big, speaks frankly and loves philosophy, travel and teaching. Details bore you; meaning thrills you.
mercury.capricorn: Mercury in Capricorn is practical, structured and strategic. You think in plans, speak with authority and have a wonderfully dry wit.
mercury.aquarius: Mercury in Aquarius is original, inventive and future-minded. You think outside every box and love ideas that could change the world.
mercury.pisces: Mercury in Pisces thinks in images, feelings and intuitions. You are poetic and psychic, and you understand people without words. Write your dreams down.

venus.aries: Venus in Aries loves boldly and honestly, enjoys the chase and wants passion with independence. You fall fast; keep the fire fed.
venus.taurus: Venus in Taurus, at home in her own sign, loves sensually and loyally. Touch, food, beauty and steadiness are your love languages.
venus.gemini: Venus in Gemini loves through conversation, wit and play. You need a partner who is also a friend and who keeps your mind dancing.
venus.cancer: Venus in Cancer loves tenderly, protectively and for keeps. You show love by caring for people, and you need emotional safety to open up.
venus.leo: Venus in Leo loves generously, warmly and with flair. Romance, grand gestures and loyal adoration make you feel cherished.
venus.virgo: Venus in Virgo loves through devotion and acts of service. You show care in practical ways and appreciate someone who notices the small things.
venus.libra: Venus in Libra, in her own sign, loves gracefully and seeks true partnership, beauty and fairness. Harmony is your romance.
venus.scorpio: Venus in Scorpio loves deeply, intensely and with total loyalty. You want soul-level intimacy; anything less leaves you cold.
venus.sagittarius: Venus in Sagittarius loves freely and adventurously. You need a partner who shares your laughter, your journeys and your love of freedom.
venus.capricorn: Venus in Capricorn loves seriously and steadily. You value commitment, reliability and a love that grows stronger with time.
venus.aquarius: Venus in Aquarius loves with friendship first and freedom always. You are drawn to the unusual and need room to be yourself.
venus.pisces: Venus in Pisces, exalted here, loves selflessly, romantically and spiritually. You see the best in people; make sure they see it in you too.

mars.aries: Mars in Aries, in its own sign, acts boldly and instantly. You have abundant energy and courage; let it out through movement and honest action.
mars.taurus: Mars in Taurus acts slowly but unstoppably. You have tremendous stamina and determination, and you take a lot of pushing before you push back.
mars.gemini: Mars in Gemini acts through words and ideas. You fight with wit, multitask brilliantly and need variety to stay motivated.
mars.cancer: Mars in Cancer acts from feeling and fights for family. Your drive is protective; anger may come out sideways, so let it be honest.
mars.leo: Mars in Leo acts with heart, confidence and flair. You are a natural leader and fight for pride, love and creative freedom.
mars.virgo: Mars in Virgo acts with precision and skill. You work hard and well, and you channel energy into improving things. Watch for burnout.
mars.libra: Mars in Libra acts through cooperation and diplomacy. You fight for fairness, though asserting your own needs can be the harder battle.
mars.scorpio: Mars in Scorpio acts with intensity, strategy and staying power. You do not quit, you do not forget, and your desire runs deep.
mars.sagittarius: Mars in Sagittarius acts with enthusiasm and fights for beliefs. You need adventure and a cause; routine drains you.
mars.capricorn: Mars in Capricorn, exalted here, acts with discipline and ambition. You are a strategist who achieves goals through patient effort.
mars.aquarius: Mars in Aquarius acts for causes, change and freedom. You rebel with purpose, and you work best with your community.
mars.pisces: Mars in Pisces acts from intuition and compassion. Your energy ebbs and flows like the tide; creative and spiritual work feeds it best.

jupiter.aries: Jupiter in Aries brings luck through courage and new starts. Your faith grows every time you take a brave first step.
jupiter.taurus: Jupiter in Taurus brings abundance through patience, the land and the senses. Slow growth makes you rich in more ways than money.
jupiter.gemini: Jupiter in Gemini grows through learning, writing and connection. Every conversation can open a door for you.
jupiter.cancer: Jupiter in Cancer, exalted here, brings blessings through home, family and care. Your generosity of heart is your fortune.
jupiter.leo: Jupiter in Leo grows through creativity, joy and generosity. When you shine for others, luck shines on you.
jupiter.virgo: Jupiter in Virgo grows through skill, service and health. Small daily improvements add up to great good fortune.
jupiter.libra: Jupiter in Libra brings luck through partnership, fairness and beauty. Your relationships are where life opens up.
jupiter.scorpio: Jupiter in Scorpio grows through depth, research and transformation. Your gifts deepen every time you face the shadow.
jupiter.sagittarius: Jupiter in Sagittarius, its own sign, brings luck through travel, faith and teaching. Your optimism truly is magic.
jupiter.capricorn: Jupiter in Capricorn grows through discipline and long effort. Your fortune is built, not given, and it lasts.
jupiter.aquarius: Jupiter in Aquarius grows through community, causes and new ideas. Your luck comes through friends and the future.
jupiter.pisces: Jupiter in Pisces, a traditional home, brings blessings through compassion, spirituality and imagination. Faith carries you.

saturn.aries: Saturn in Aries teaches patience with your own fire, and the discipline to act wisely instead of quickly.
saturn.taurus: Saturn in Taurus teaches you to build security slowly, to value yourself, and to let go of fear around money.
saturn.gemini: Saturn in Gemini teaches you to trust your mind and voice, building real expertise through steady study.
saturn.cancer: Saturn in Cancer teaches you to build emotional security from within and to make peace with family patterns.
saturn.leo: Saturn in Leo teaches you to shine without needing permission, earning a confidence that no one can take away.
saturn.virgo: Saturn in Virgo teaches mastery of craft and health, and the hard lesson that good enough is often perfect.
saturn.libra: Saturn in Libra, exalted here, teaches committed partnership, fairness and the beauty of keeping your word.
saturn.scorpio: Saturn in Scorpio teaches you to face fear, loss and power with courage, and to trust after hurt.
saturn.sagittarius: Saturn in Sagittarius teaches you to build a faith and philosophy that hold up when tested.
saturn.capricorn: Saturn in Capricorn, in its own sign, teaches mastery, authority and responsibility worn with grace.
saturn.aquarius: Saturn in Aquarius, its traditional home, teaches you to build community and to belong without losing yourself.
saturn.pisces: Saturn in Pisces teaches you to give shape to dreams and boundaries to compassion.

node.aries: North Node in Aries: your soul grows by choosing yourself, acting with courage and leading, after many lifetimes of keeping the peace.
node.taurus: North Node in Taurus: you grow by slowing down, valuing simple pleasures and building steady security, letting go of crisis and intensity.
node.gemini: North Node in Gemini: you grow by asking questions, listening, learning and staying curious, rather than preaching what you already believe.
node.cancer: North Node in Cancer: you grow by nurturing, feeling and making a home, softening a lifetime habit of achievement and control.
node.leo: North Node in Leo: you grow by stepping into the spotlight, creating from the heart and letting yourself be seen as an individual.
node.virgo: North Node in Virgo: you grow through practical service, routine and craft, grounding a dreamy soul in daily devotion.
node.libra: North Node in Libra: you grow through partnership, compromise and seeing others clearly, after a long habit of going it alone.
node.scorpio: North Node in Scorpio: you grow through depth, shared intimacy and transformation, releasing an over-attachment to comfort.
node.sagittarius: North Node in Sagittarius: you grow by trusting your intuition, seeking meaning and adventure, beyond endless facts and chatter.
node.capricorn: North Node in Capricorn: you grow by taking responsibility, building a public calling and standing on your own feet.
node.aquarius: North Node in Aquarius: you grow by joining your community, serving the future and letting others shine too.
node.pisces: North Node in Pisces: you grow by surrendering, trusting spirit and opening to compassion, loosening the need to fix everything.

rising.aries: With Aries rising you meet life head-on. People see you as direct, energetic and brave, sometimes a little fiery. You start quickly and act first, and your body likes movement. Your path asks you to lead, and to remember that not everything is a race. Mars, as your chart ruler, is a key to your whole story.
rising.taurus: With Taurus rising you come across as calm, grounded and pleasant to be around. People trust your steadiness and often find you beautiful in an earthy way. You approach new situations slowly and on your own terms. Venus rules your chart, so beauty, comfort and values shape the road you walk.
rising.gemini: With Gemini rising you greet the world with curiosity, wit and quick words. People see you as youthful, chatty and clever, and you are often in motion, phone in hand. You learn by trying many things. Mercury rules your chart, so your mind and how you use it are the threads of your story.
rising.cancer: With Cancer rising you meet the world with a soft heart and a careful shell. People sense your warmth and often come to you for comfort. You read a room instantly and protect yourself until it feels safe. The Moon rules your chart, so your moods and the lunar cycle shape your path more than most.
rising.leo: With Leo rising you walk in like the sun coming up. People notice you, feel your warmth and expect a bit of sparkle. You lead naturally and do best with room to express yourself. The Sun rules your chart, so your Sun sign and its house carry extra weight in your story.
rising.virgo: With Virgo rising you meet the world with a careful eye and a helpful hand. People see you as capable, modest, neat and observant. You prepare, analyse and improve. Mercury rules your chart, so how you think, work and serve becomes the shape of your life.
rising.libra: With Libra rising you greet the world with grace, charm and diplomacy. People find you easy to like and you have an eye for beauty and balance. You come alive in partnership. Venus rules your chart, so love, art and relationships are central to the path you walk.
rising.scorpio: With Scorpio rising you have a magnetic, intense presence; people sense depths before you have said a word. You are private, perceptive and slow to trust, and you notice everything. Your life tends to move through powerful transformations. Mars and Pluto rule your chart and tell much of your story.
rising.sagittarius: With Sagittarius rising you meet life like an adventure. People see you as friendly, open, funny and a little restless. You need freedom and a horizon to aim at. Jupiter rules your chart, so growth, travel, faith and learning are the roads that open for you.
rising.capricorn: With Capricorn rising you come across as composed, capable and older than your years. People trust you with responsibility early. You approach life with a plan and grow lighter and more playful with age. Saturn rules your chart, so patience and mastery are the keys to your path.
rising.aquarius: With Aquarius rising you greet the world as an original. People see you as friendly but hard to pin down, unusual, smart and independent. You need freedom and community in equal measure. Saturn and Uranus rule your chart, blending structure with sudden awakening in your story.
rising.pisces: With Pisces rising you meet the world softly, dreamily, with open sensitivity. People find you gentle, intuitive and a little otherworldly. You absorb your surroundings, so choose them with care. Jupiter and Neptune rule your chart, and imagination and spirit run through your whole path.

outer_generation.uranus: Uranus in {sign} marks your generation's urge to break free through {kw}. You share this awakening with everyone born within a few years of you; its house in your chart shows where you personally feel it.
outer_generation.neptune: Neptune in {sign} colours your generation's dreams with {kw}. It is a shared longing; the house it falls in tells where you feel that longing most.
outer_generation.pluto: Pluto in {sign} marks your generation's deep transformation around {kw}. It is collective soul work; its house shows where in your life you meet that power.

aspects.conjunction: A conjunction fuses two energies into one. They act together, for better and for worse, and it can be hard to tell where one ends and the other begins.
aspects.sextile: A sextile is an open door, a friendly opportunity between two energies that rewards a little effort.
aspects.square: A square is friction that builds strength. Two energies pull in different directions, pushing you to grow, act and resolve.
aspects.trine: A trine is an easy flow, a natural talent. The two energies support each other so smoothly you may take the gift for granted.
aspects.opposition: An opposition is a seesaw. Two energies face each other across the chart, and the work is balance, often played out through other people.

aspect_template.fusing: Your {a_noun} and your {b_noun} are fused. {a_short_cap} and {b_short} speak with one voice in you, which gives that part of your life real concentrated power. The work is to notice when one drowns out the other.
aspect_template.flowing: Your {a_noun} and your {b_noun} support each other easily. {a_short_cap} and {b_short} cooperate without much effort, a gift worth using on purpose rather than leaving idle.
aspect_template.tense: Your {a_noun} and your {b_noun} push against each other. {a_short_cap} wants one thing while {b_short} wants another, and that friction, handled honestly, becomes one of your greatest sources of drive and growth.

aspect_bespoke.sun_moon:fusing: Born near a New Moon, your will and your feelings are one. You know what you want and you feel it in your bones, which gives you focus and a fresh-start spirit. Remember to step back sometimes and see yourself from outside.
aspect_bespoke.sun_moon:tense: Your will and your feelings pull in different directions, so you may feel torn between what you want and what you need. That inner tug is a creative engine; honouring both, instead of choosing one, is the art of your life.
aspect_bespoke.sun_moon:flowing: Your will and your feelings work together. What you want and what you need are in harmony, which gives you a natural ease and inner peace that others can feel.
aspect_bespoke.moon_venus:flowing: Your heart and your loving nature work together beautifully. You give and receive affection easily and make people feel cared for.
aspect_bespoke.moon_venus:tense: What comforts you and what you desire do not always match, so love can feel complicated. Learning to honour both needs makes you wise about the heart.
aspect_bespoke.venus_mars:fusing: Love and desire are fused in you. You are magnetic and passionate, and you know what you want in romance.
aspect_bespoke.venus_mars:tense: Love and desire spark against each other: attraction is electric, sometimes stormy. Passion is never boring for you.
aspect_bespoke.venus_mars:flowing: Love and desire flow together easily. You are naturally charming and know how to balance giving and taking.
aspect_bespoke.sun_saturn:tense: Your light meets Saturn's hard lessons. You may have felt held back or judged young, which built resilience. Later in life this becomes real authority and grit.
aspect_bespoke.sun_saturn:fusing: Your sense of self and Saturn are bound together. You are serious, disciplined and responsible, often older than your years, and grow lighter with time.
aspect_bespoke.moon_saturn:tense: Your feelings were not always welcome early on, so you learned to be self-reliant. Your healing comes from letting yourself be held.
aspect_bespoke.moon_saturn:fusing: Your heart wears armour. You are emotionally dependable and strong, and the work is giving yourself the tenderness you give others.
aspect_bespoke.sun_jupiter:fusing: Your light is magnified by Jupiter: generous, hopeful, often lucky. Just watch for too much of a good thing.
aspect_bespoke.sun_jupiter:flowing: Life tends to meet you halfway. Optimism and opportunity come naturally, and your faith in people is often rewarded.
aspect_bespoke.mars_saturn:tense: Your drive meets resistance, which taught you to persevere. You may stop and start, but what you finish is solid.
aspect_bespoke.sun_pluto:tense: Your will meets Pluto's power. You go through profound reinventions and power struggles, and you come out of each one stronger.
aspect_bespoke.moon_pluto:tense: Your emotions run volcanic. You feel everything at full depth, and learning to trust and to let go is your lifelong alchemy.
aspect_bespoke.mercury_neptune:tense: Your mind and your imagination blur; brilliant for poetry, dreams and intuition, tricky for paperwork. Write things down.
aspect_bespoke.venus_neptune:fusing: Your love is idealistic and spiritual. You see the divine in people, so choose those worthy of the vision.
aspect_bespoke.sun_uranus:fusing: Your identity is electric: original, rebellious, unpredictable. You were never meant to fit in.
aspect_bespoke.moon_uranus:tense: Your moods change like lightning and you need emotional freedom. Unusual people and paths suit your heart.

patterns.grand_trine: You have a Grand Trine in {element} signs between {bodies}: a closed circle of easy energy, a deep natural gift. It can be so comfortable that you forget to use it, so put it to work on purpose.
patterns.t_square: You have a T-Square with {apex} at the apex, pressured by the opposition of {a} and {b}. This is a powerful engine of drive and achievement, and {apex} is the place where you resolve the tension.
patterns.stellium_sign: You have a stellium in {sign}: {bodies} gathered in one sign. {sign} energy runs through your life like a strong current, and the themes of {sign} will feel central to who you are.
patterns.stellium_house: You have a stellium in your {house} house: {bodies} gathered in {house_desc}. A great deal of your life's energy and story is concentrated here.

fire.label: Fire
fire.strong: Strong fire gives you passion, courage and enthusiasm; you are energised by action and inspiration.
fire.weak: With little fire, motivation can be quiet. Candles, movement, sunlight and play help kindle your spark.

earth.label: Earth
earth.strong: Strong earth makes you practical, patient and grounded; you trust what is real and build things that last.
earth.weak: With little earth, the practical side may feel hard. Gardening, routines, food and time in nature ground you.

air.label: Air
air.strong: Strong air makes you curious, social and full of ideas; you live through the mind and conversation.
air.weak: With little air, stepping back to see things objectively may be harder. Talking, writing and fresh air help.

water.label: Water
water.strong: Strong water makes you intuitive, emotional and empathic; you feel your way through life.
water.weak: With little water, feelings may stay in the background. Baths, music, tears and moon rituals help them flow.

modality.cardinal: A cardinal emphasis makes you a starter and initiator.
modality.fixed: A fixed emphasis makes you steady, determined and loyal, and sometimes stubborn.
modality.mutable: A mutable emphasis makes you adaptable, flexible and good at change.

lunation.new_moon: A New Moon is the dark seed time, for intentions, quiet beginnings and planting wishes. In {sign}, set intentions around {kw}.
lunation.full_moon: A Full Moon is the harvest of light: things come to a head, feelings rise and what was hidden is revealed. In {sign}, notice what culminates around {kw}, and release what is done.
lunation.eclipse: Eclipses are wild cards, turning points that shake loose what is stuck and redirect the path. This one in {sign} stirs change around {kw}. Astrologers traditionally advise watching rather than working big spells under an eclipse.

retrograde.mercury: Mercury retrograde, about three times a year for three weeks: a season to review, revise, reconnect and back things up. Expect delays and crossed wires; it is excellent for finishing old projects and hearing from people from the past.
retrograde.venus: Venus retrograde, every eighteen months: old loves and old values resurface. A time to reflect on what and whom you truly value, not to start new romances or radical makeovers.
retrograde.mars: Mars retrograde, every two years: energy turns inward. Push less, plan more, and revisit old battles and unfinished goals.
retrograde.jupiter: Jupiter retrograde: growth turns inward; a season for inner faith and reflection on what really makes you feel abundant.
retrograde.saturn: Saturn retrograde: a review of responsibilities and structures. What commitments still serve you?
retrograde.uranus: Uranus retrograde: inner awakening; the revolution is happening inside before it shows outside.
retrograde.neptune: Neptune retrograde: the fog lifts a little and illusions become clearer.
retrograde.pluto: Pluto retrograde: deep inner transformation and shadow work move to the front.

transit.sextile: {t} opens a door for your natal {n}

transit_planet.sun: a few days of spotlight and vitality
transit_planet.mercury: a few days of messages, conversations and decisions
transit_planet.venus: a sweet few days for love, beauty and money
transit_planet.mars: a charged week of energy, drive and possible friction
transit_planet.jupiter: a season of growth, opportunity and optimism
transit_planet.saturn: a long season of tests, structure and maturing
transit_planet.uranus: a period of surprise, freedom and sudden change
transit_planet.neptune: a dreamy, sensitive, sometimes foggy period
transit_planet.pluto: a deep, slow transformation that changes you for good

returns.saturn: Your Saturn return is a coming-of-age, around 29 and again near 58. Life asks you to grow up in the area Saturn rules in your chart, drop what is not truly yours, and commit to what is. It is hard, and it is the foundation of the next thirty years.
returns.jupiter: Your Jupiter return comes every twelve years and opens a new cycle of growth, luck and faith. Plant the seeds you want to see grow for the next twelve years.
returns.node: Your nodal return, every 18.6 years, brings a fated feeling: people, places and choices that point you back toward your soul path.
